steps.en: Install the script (and ffmpeg if you want best quality or audio extraction)
steps.zh: 装好脚本（要最佳画质或抽音频就再装 ffmpeg）

steps.en: Run it on a video or playlist URL, with an output template for file names
steps.zh: 对视频或播放列表地址运行它，用输出模板定文件名

steps.en: Finds the extractor for that site and reads the page's formats and metadata
steps.zh: 找到这个站点的抽取器，读出可用格式和元数据

steps.en: Picks best video plus best audio by default, downloads both and muxes them with ffmpeg
steps.zh: 默认挑最佳视频和最佳音频，分别下载后用 ffmpeg 合成一个文件

steps.en: Writes the file under the name your template produced
steps.zh: 按模板生成的名字把文件写到磁盘

value.en: A script gets the same download command for every supported site, with predictable file names
value.zh: 脚本对每个支持的站点都用同一条下载命令，文件名可预期
